item.name: Create a new Group in the vault

request.name: Create a new Group in the vault

description.content:
Pass a vault name in the `vault` field and the group `label`.

Example of the request that creates a new group in `Team` vault with
`external_id` as `client-123`, label `John Doe`,
ssh port `22`, and ssh credentials in `username` and `password`
properties, and SSH key in the `key` property:

- path: `/v1/group/client-123/`
- body:
  ```
  {
    "vault": "Team",
    "label": "John Doe",
    "ssh": {
      "port": 22,
      "credentials": {
        "username": "username",
        "password": "password",
        "key": {
          "label": "shared with the team",
          "private": "-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\nb3Blbn..."
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ```

Optionally, pass the parent group `external_id` in the `group` field
instead of the `vault`.
Create a parent group via this API before creating a nested group.

description.content:
# Welcome You are viewing the REST API documentation for the Termius API Bridge. It is an interactive page that allows you to explore the API endpoints and their parameters. ## Get started Termius API Bridge is a REST API that enables you to create and delete hosts as well as create groups in your Termius vaults. Example of the API call with `curl` for the API Bridge deployed to the `localhost:8080`: 
 curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/host/test/ \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{
       "vault": "Vault_name",
       "address": "example.com",
       "label": "Database",
       "ssh": {
         "port": 22,
         "credentials": {
           "username": "username",
           "password": "password"
         }
       }
     }'
The full documentation and the list of the API endpoints is down bellow on the page. To try the API endpoints, click on the **Try it out** button and fill in the required fields: **path** and **body**. ## Help If you have any questions about Termius API Bridge please send your requests on [our support portal](https://support.termius.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). Contact Support: Email: support@termius.com
